text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends prohibiting standing at all times on both sides of Tanis Crescent at the curve in the road south of Kingston Road. Currently, parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Tanis Crescent.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the west and south side of Tanis Crescent, between a point 55 metres south of Kingston Road and a point 51 metres further south and east. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the east and north side of Tanis Crescent, between a point 64 metres south of Kingston Road and a point 26 metres further south and east.
